idea: A city tree cools the street it stands on — plant one, keep one.
story: One street tree cools its block.

copy.headline: One tree cools a whole street
copy.body: Shade breaks the heat a road holds. The canopy over your street is the cheapest cooling a city has.

elements.whyHere: Names the campaign before the claim lands.
Carries the single idea: one tree changes a street.
Three canopies strung along a route read as a street of trees, not one stock photo.
Explains why shade matters, in the user's own words.
Who is asking, and where to go.
Carries the eye from the canopy down to the action, and lands as the underline beneath it.

relationships.purpose: Puts the trees physically in front of the campaign label.

gesture.purpose: The canopy overlaps its own label so the trees sit in front of the campaign name.
